case_number: 2024 INSC 158; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO(S). 1610 OF 2023 & 1611 OF 2023
summary: Appeals against NDPS Act conviction for narcotic possession; recovery from vehicle during transit; panch witnesses not examined; sampling procedure defects raised; FSL report reliability challenged due to chain of custody issues; A-3/A-4 absent at seizure scene; concurrent findings by lower courts; appeals dismissed.
legal_provisions_cited: Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.8(c), s.20(b)(ii)(c)
Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 s.52A
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; conviction and sentence upheld; impugned High Court judgment affirmed.
